fullContentHtml:
UKPSC Lecturer Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) has released the admit card for the post of Lecturer in various subjects. This recruitment was released for 808 posts. Applications for the SSC CGL Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 31 December 2025, to 20 January 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 11, 18 & 23 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their UKPSC Lecturer Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 30 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 31 December 2025
  • Last Date : 20 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 January 2026
  • Correction Date : 20 January 2026 to 06 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 11, 18 & 23 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 25 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 166.36/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 76.36/-
  • PH : Rs. 16.36/-
  • Orphan (Anath) : Rs. 00/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

  • Download Admit Card / Exam Date Notice

  • Download Notification
  • Download Syllabus
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UKPSC Lecturer Admit Card 2026?

UKPSC Lecturer Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
